title: route.fade
description: Wild Routes (WR7): the server moves the player in about `ticks` (into a dungeon, down its stairs, out of it). The client fades out now (over at most 10 ticks), holds the player and stays dark until it has arrived and the world around it is drawn, then fades in.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
